svg.aria-label: Affine block ids. Block b of a group starts at byte b times its block size, so its kernel row is b times R. Group A blocks are 0.4 of a page: ids 2 and 7 cross a page end and are holes. Group B blocks are 0.1 of a page. Page 1 and page 3 belong to A, page 2 to B.
svg.text: Affine block ids over large pages
Toy sizes: a page is 10 units; a group A block is 4 units, a group B block is 1 unit.
Kernel row of block b = b × R; byte offset = b × block bytes. No lookup table. Admission counts the minimum blocks per page (2 for A).
